title: Registre incrémental de preuves AAM O93_1
baseline_registry: registre_prouves.json (O93_0 historique; non modifié par cette annexe)

proofs.requirement: RAG retrieval and selected language capsule are linked in the user-facing chat response.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Actual generation invocation records capsule, prompt/context hashes and citations; rejected candidates are distinguished from delivered fallback.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: A dedicated CLI/API trains a chat-language capsule distinct from skill acquisition.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Training control is visible in the desktop UI; completed capsules become selectable and are invoked by chat.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Training pause/resume and stop checkpoints have explicit, tested semantics; partial capsules are not published.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Chat controls and feedback region stay within screen bounds under tested Xvfb geometry.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Scheduled catalogue refreshes defer while a long task occupies UI, avoiding blocking modal dialogs.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Autonomy starts by default, runs a pulse, survives a user request, can be manually stopped/restarted and closes cleanly with AAM.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: A held-out row in the real SMS dataset is recovered from RAG, included in the prompt, and a matching trained capsule is invoked; the candidate is rejected and cited extractive fallback is delivered.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: End-to-end acceptance over all 5,574 SMS rows.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Sparse proximity optimization matches exhaustive oracle within 1e-12 including self-exclusion and no-intersection cases.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

proofs.requirement: Package integrity, clean extraction, manifest verification, CLI smoke and target tests are validated for final archives.
proofs.scope: local bounded unless explicitly stated otherwise

interpretation: Ce registre ne prédit ni succès ni échec général du modèle. PASS_BOUNDED limite le résultat aux cas, données et environnements consignés.
